d: Long, straight ash-grey hair with blunt bangs and a small black hair clip frames a youthful face with sharp, narrow light-blue eyes. The build is slender with a large bust and curved hips. The outfit consists of a white collared shirt under a dark navy blue military-style jacket draped over the shoulders, paired with a black crop top, black high-waisted shorts, dark navy thigh-high stockings with grey knee pads, and black lace-up boots. Signature details include gold braided cords on the jacket and a large, futuristic black mechanical bow with glowing cyan accents.
